title: S5 natcmp (M16): n4bp60 vs ship60 (default) or nat60, back to back, quiet-gated, attract-long pad, 3D-only score (one arm per run-matrix call)
notes: Same run settings as matrix-s5-baseline.json (M8, window 20261125-1804) for the ship60, nat60 and n4bp60 arms; only cold_run (false), repeats (1) and order differ.

natcmp\cmp-run.ps1 calls run-matrix once per arm (-Only <arm> -Repeats 1 -NoCold) so it can gate on the nongame CPU load between runs; the ABBA order, the base arm (vs ship|nat) and the unscored primes are set by cmp-run.ps1, not by this file.

arms.note: Xenos ship default arm, framerate_limit=60 (same as the window's ship60)
native default arm, native_fps_limit=60 (same as the window's nat60)
native4bp (nativefinal2 + AOT placement pack, fingerprint 39129c4c059be5f0), native_fps_limit=60 (same as the window's n4bp60)
